posts.text:
ayyyoo they did our distillation thing for language models! Literally, with the equivalent of mixup :)

One thing it seems they had to do, is to only do this for part of the distillation, and then finish on "pure" examples. We probably should have also done that back then!

My way of contributing to PyTorch since I joined: complain and whine until something happens :D

I was super happy by PyTorch team's reaction on this one! I complained about their current RNG API. I think it's horrible. I made a prototype of what I think it should look like, and
posts.quoted: We have an experimental (currently private, but we'll soon be promoting it to public) stateless RNG API in PyTorch that does not have this problem, you should try it! https:// github.com/pytorch/pytorc h/blob/main/torch/func/_random.py …
